about_the_game:
For more information, please check out the full game!

"Well, have I been turned into a horse???"

Yes, you have, Leappa. Get used to it, grab carrots, and be ready to turn into more animals that move differently!

Unfamiliar Leaper Movements

In this game, you don't just move up, down, left and right! Instead, you move as "leapers". They move in a specific angle about an axis, a fixed distance each time, and cannot be blocked. Think about the knight in chess, which is a classic leaper! Getting use to the move patterns is the key to victory. In this demo, you can experience the movements of the horse and the rabbit.

Fun Traps and Items

On the map of each level, all kinds of traps and items are waiting for you. We got spikes, portals, crates, springs and many more! They interact with each other in unique ways. Understand and use them to your advantage! There will be more traps and items in the full game than this demo.

Intense Boss Fights

Want some different experience? Behold, boss fights! In boss levels, you don't have to carefully come up with a solution to a puzzle. What you have to do is dodge the boss's rapid attacks, and grab carrots to strike back! In this demo, you can fight one boss.

Be Casual

Find some levels too hard? Just skip them! Every level is optional. You can advance to any level without completing previous levels.

Now go get the carrots, Leappa! Most importantly, you gotta turn back into a rabbit!

name: Carrotour Demo
short_description: This is the demo of Carrotour, a grid-based puzzle game where you utilize various "leaper" movements to navigate around obstacles and grab delicious carrots. Also, be prepared for intense boss battles featuring bullet hells!
